quests.hint: Adjective describing someone who lies or cheats. It would be ____ to keep the extra change the cashier gave me.
quests.explanation: DIS- + HONEST = DISHONEST. The prefix DIS- means 'not', reversing the meaning of the adjective HONEST.

quests.hint: Verb meaning to stop a device or system from working. You can ____ notifications in the settings menu.
quests.explanation: DIS- + ABLE = DISABLE. The prefix DIS- reverses the meaning, turning ABLE into a verb meaning to make something unable to function.

quests.hint: Noun or verb meaning a lack of trust or belief in someone. Years of broken promises left her with deep ____ for the company.
quests.explanation: DIS- + TRUST = DISTRUST. The prefix DIS- means 'not' or 'the opposite of', reversing the meaning of TRUST.

quests.hint: Adjective describing something that feels physically pleasant and relaxing. This is the most ____ chair I have ever sat in.
quests.explanation: COMFORT + -ABLE = COMFORTABLE. The suffix -ABLE means 'able to be' or 'providing', turning the noun COMFORT into an adjective.

quests.hint: Adjective describing something right or appropriate for a particular purpose. This dress isn't ____ for a job interview.
quests.explanation: SUIT + -ABLE = SUITABLE. The suffix -ABLE means 'able to be', turning the verb SUIT into an adjective meaning 'fitting' or 'appropriate'.

quests.hint: Adjective describing something worth a lot of money or very useful. Her advice turned out to be extremely ____.
quests.explanation: VALUE + -ABLE = VALUABLE. The suffix -ABLE means 'having', turning the noun VALUE into an adjective.

quests.hint: Verb meaning to express disapproval of someone or something. Reviewers ____d the film for its slow pacing.
quests.explanation: CRITIC + -IZE = CRITICIZE. The suffix -IZE means 'to make' or 'to act as', turning the noun CRITIC into a verb.

quests.hint: Verb meaning to share or understand someone's feelings of sadness or trouble. It's easy to ____ with someone who's had a rough week.
quests.explanation: SYMPATHY + -IZE = SYMPATHIZE. The suffix -IZE turns the noun SYMPATHY into a verb meaning to feel or express that emotion.

quests.hint: Verb meaning to say sorry for doing something wrong. He called to ____ for missing the meeting.
quests.explanation: APOLOGY + -IZE = APOLOGIZE. The suffix -IZE turns the noun APOLOGY into a verb meaning to give one.

quests.hint: Noun for the period of a person's life when they are a child. She spent her ____ in a small fishing village.
quests.explanation: CHILD + -HOOD = CHILDHOOD. The suffix -HOOD means 'the state or period of', turning CHILD into a noun naming that stage of life.

quests.hint: Noun for the area around where someone lives, along with the people there. Kids used to play in the street all over our ____.
quests.explanation: NEIGHBOR + -HOOD = NEIGHBORHOOD. The suffix -HOOD means 'the state or area of', turning NEIGHBOR into a noun naming the surrounding community.

quests.hint: Noun for the period of life after someone is fully grown. Moving out of your parents' house often marks the start of ____.
quests.explanation: ADULT + -HOOD = ADULTHOOD. The suffix -HOOD means 'the state or period of', turning ADULT into a noun naming that stage of life.

quests.hint: Noun for the way in which two things are not the same. Can you spot the ____ between these two photos?
quests.explanation: DIFFER + -ENCE = DIFFERENCE. The suffix -ENCE turns the verb DIFFER into a noun naming that quality of being unlike.

quests.hint: Noun for the state of being real or living. Scientists are still debating the ____ of life on other planets.
quests.explanation: EXIST + -ENCE = EXISTENCE. The suffix -ENCE turns the verb EXIST into a noun naming the state of being.

quests.hint: Noun for help given to someone. The charity provides financial ____ to families in need.
quests.explanation: ASSIST + -ANCE = ASSISTANCE. The suffix -ANCE turns the verb ASSIST into a noun naming the help given.

quests.hint: Adjective relating to the whole world. Climate change is considered a ____ crisis.
quests.explanation: GLOBE + -AL = GLOBAL. The suffix -AL means 'relating to', turning the noun GLOBE into an adjective.

quests.hint: Adjective relating to a specific area rather than the whole country. The bakery only sells its bread through ____ distributors.
quests.explanation: REGION + -AL = REGIONAL. The suffix -AL means 'relating to', turning the noun REGION into an adjective.

quests.hint: Adjective relating to an entire country. The team will represent their country in the ____ championship.
quests.explanation: NATION + -AL = NATIONAL. The suffix -AL means 'relating to', turning the noun NATION into an adjective.

quests.hint: Noun for a person or company that pays others to work for them. My ____ offers excellent health benefits.
quests.explanation: EMPLOY + -ER = EMPLOYER. The suffix -ER names the person who performs the action of the verb EMPLOY, meaning to hire someone.

quests.hint: Noun for a person who possesses something. The restaurant's ____ greets every customer at the door.
quests.explanation: OWN + -ER = OWNER. The suffix -ER turns the verb OWN into a noun naming the person who possesses something.

quests.hint: Noun for a person who plans how something will look or work. The ____ chose a bold color palette for the new logo.
quests.explanation: DESIGN + -ER = DESIGNER. The suffix -ER turns the verb DESIGN into a noun naming the person who designs.

quests.hint: Adjective describing someone with a strong imagination and original ideas. The team needed a more ____ approach to solve the problem.
quests.explanation: CREATE + -IVE = CREATIVE. The suffix -IVE means 'tending to' or 'having the ability to', turning the verb CREATE into an adjective.

quests.hint: Adjective describing someone or something pleasing to look at. The new store window display was very ____.
quests.explanation: ATTRACT + -IVE = ATTRACTIVE. The suffix -IVE means 'tending to', turning the verb ATTRACT into an adjective.

quests.hint: Adjective describing someone who offers help and encouragement. My parents have always been very ____ of my career choices.
quests.explanation: SUPPORT + -IVE = SUPPORTIVE. The suffix -IVE means 'tending to', turning the verb SUPPORT into an adjective.

quests.hint: Noun for the tools or items needed for a particular purpose. The gym just bought some new weightlifting ____.
quests.explanation: EQUIP + -MENT = EQUIPMENT. The suffix -MENT turns the verb EQUIP into a noun naming the tools provided.

quests.hint: Noun for the group of people who officially run a country or state. The ____ announced a new plan to fix the roads.
quests.explanation: GOVERN + -MENT = GOVERNMENT. The suffix -MENT turns the verb GOVERN into a noun naming the ruling body.

quests.hint: Noun for something said or written clearly to express a fact or opinion. The company released a ____ apologizing for the delay.
quests.explanation: STATE + -MENT = STATEMENT. The suffix -MENT turns the verb STATE into a noun naming what is expressed.

quests.hint: Adjective describing someone who doesn't pay enough attention and makes mistakes. That was a ____ mistake that cost us the client.
quests.explanation: CARE + -LESS = CARELESS. The suffix -LESS means 'without', turning the noun CARE into an adjective meaning 'without care'.

quests.hint: Adjective describing something that seems to have no end. The desert stretched out in ____ waves of sand.
quests.explanation: END + -LESS = ENDLESS. The suffix -LESS means 'without', turning the noun END into an adjective meaning 'without an end'.

quests.hint: Adjective describing someone who is considerate of others, or who thinks carefully. It was so ____ of you to remember my birthday.
quests.explanation: THOUGHT + -FUL = THOUGHTFUL. The suffix -FUL means 'full of', turning the noun THOUGHT into an adjective meaning 'full of consideration'.
